metadata.title: Project ROI and cash flow, 1974–1983
metadata.scope: Five-entity project ecosystem, pre-tax and unlevered; not shareholder ROI or consolidated legal accounts
metadata.scenario: Reassessed Logix sales, clone programme and Autodesk sponsorship; pre-tax project scope
metadata.accounting_status: Planning cash-cost and depreciation bridge, not audited GAAP financial statements

definitions.quarterly_pretax_roi: Quarter EBIT / average opening and closing operating assets (net modeled fixed assets including CIP + inventory). Nonannualized pre-tax ROIC proxy; no tax assumption.
definitions.cumulative_accounting_roi: Cumulative EBIT / (cumulative capex + ending inventory). Custom since-inception accounting ROI, not annualized; do not compare directly with quarterly ROI.
definitions.cumulative_cash_return: Cumulative free cash flow / peak external funding requirement to date. Includes pre-revenue losses; excludes terminal asset-sale value. During maximum funding draw the ratio can be -100%.
definitions.free_cash_flow: Net revenue − cash operating costs − capex − change in inventory. Depreciation is deducted only for EBIT, not cash flow.
definitions.net_revenue: Customer spend less channel fees and expected promotional credits; BPI independent sales and Academy direct tuition included once.
definitions.operating_assets: Net fixed assets plus gross inventory. No AR, AP, debt, excess cash or legal-entity tax balance sheet is supplied.
definitions.peak_external_funding: Maximum cumulative negative free cash balance, starting at zero. Existing founder-equity commitments finance this requirement; they are not operating returns.

assumptions.matching: New task-bundle recurring costs replace baseline computer costs. Old Team/network and BPI attach allowances removed before new cohorts are added. Retained other receipts scale with volumes; 65% fixed/35% variable other resources and 6% 1983 escalation are explicit assumptions.
assumptions.academy: Industrial-plan course volumes and staffing retained. Requested-course mix used where available; otherwise stated mix. Direct tuition charged once. Permanent teaching payroll already funded.
assumptions.sales_end_1980: All current monthly sales use dated retail pricing; no superseded constrained-delivery series is included.
assumptions.working_capital: Two months revised recurring product costs plus revolving component credit; no terminal recovery. Capacity expansion uses $120 per extra annualised system equivalent, 5% headroom, funding one quarter before service and five-year depreciation. Requires engineering validation.
assumptions.depreciation: Straight-line zero-salvage planning lives: buildings 20y, fab tools 10y, fitout 7y, other equipment 5y; quarter after service. Explicit fab commissioning dates prevent depreciation of construction in progress.
assumptions.marketing: Replace existing generic campaign/dealer expense in the ROI bridge; underlying historical industrial file remains an independently reproducible baseline. Credits are contra-revenue, other marketing is expense.
assumptions.ownership: Five-entity project resource scope retained. Independent clone computer sales, Aion Tech retail profit and Autodesk licence receipts excluded. Only scenario chipset/software receipts and SGS royalties accrue to this scope.
exclusions: Taxes, debt/interest, equity valuations and terminal asset sales

assumptions.1981_extension: Reassessed demand through December 1982 from market_outlook.py. Dated balanced prices, 1982 process investment and Team costs included. Initial Team price uses first available 1982 snapshot; no volume savings from the unproven 2 um ramp.
assumptions.bounds: Combined demand, programme-cost and SGS-royalty scenarios; not confidence intervals.
assumptions.1980_extension: Through 1983; accepted clone launch January 1982. AutoCAD sales begin December 1982 conditional on acceptance. 1983 unit prices/costs carry December 1982; retained resources rise 6%.
assumptions.internal_royalties: Restore baseline eliminations before deriving retained costs, then eliminate the modeled $10 CP/M royalty per new Aurelia/Aurelia+ from project costs. Independent software publishers remain outside this elimination.

historical_context.use: Supports period mix of press, dealer co-op, demonstrations, PR and direct mail; proposed dealer co-op was 5% of sales. Model uses 2% of net basket receipts as its own assumption, not a quoted Logix rate.

memory_manufacturing.era_policy: ERA1 and its 6/8 MHz variants remain 55 mm2 on the original 3.0 um Micralign process. No CPU shrink or speed-bin uplift.

development_line.basis: Separate pilot bay; 25 passes/hour, eight layers, 65% OEE. No added saleable output or legacy capacity credit.

future_capital_schedule.purpose: 1.5 um selected release and matching; commissioned 1983-Q4

memory_manufacturing.boundary: Future budgets after 1982 excluded from closed-horizon cash/ROI; reported as forward commitments. Recurring RAM repair costs are inside chip costs, not charged again as pilot operations.

engineering_1982.basis: Half of paid retained Labs engineering payroll is allocated first; remainder is incremental. Pilot nonpayroll is separate. June 1982 mature 3 um RAM unit costs retained for volume; 2 um output not credited before repeatability.

policy.status: Accepted planning design; production qualification and assumed demand response unproven
policy.demand_basis: 70% Artemis128 (16 KiB card), 30% Artemis256 (32 KiB card and AION system RAM). Within each tier 80% monochrome and 20% Color II: total Mono Pro uptake 24%. Previous display-specific interest uplift scaled by 24/60; price elasticity applied once afterwards. Mix and response are scenario assumptions, not observed orders. Campaign remains $435,000; no additional price/value marketing bonus.
policy.crt_status: M36-141W period candidate; 640×400 qualification and purchase prices are assumptions, not supplier assurances.

display_revision.interpretation: Current hardware and manufacturing policy; ERAv1 remains at 3 um. Current sales and ROI use the same dated retail prices.

reassessment_inputs.status: Alternative-history planning forecast, not observed market data or negotiated price schedule
reassessment_inputs.geography: Worldwide microcomputer unit shipments; Logix includes UK distributor shipments. Five clone brands counted only for their compatible product lines. Other legacy products of those brands remain in other manufacturers.
demand_basis: Author assumption: foresight aligns production and purchased components with finite customer demand. No factory bottleneck or lost sales; no infinite demand, automatic sell-through of arbitrary production, or zero capital costs.

Budget colour and 5 MB configurations enter in May 1980. Native application value, two drives and complete-package pricing improve new-business conversion; IBM has a March 1982 substitute-OS launch, not the historical DOS ecosystem.

Gross factors are explicit low-confidence scenario judgements relative to the frozen same-quarter 1980/81/82 baseline, not measured price elasticities. 1983 uses original 1982 quarters. No historical Apple/IBM dominance is imposed.

Budget purchases substitute for existing Artemis configurations inside the family total; 10/15 percentage points of 1981/82 Logix mix shift from Aurelia+ to Artemis. Clone cannibalisation is deducted once.
Demand scenarios remain finite; capacity follows each scenario. Actual support and supplier qualification are assumed funded, not free. 1983 holds 1982 pricing/costs.
